originalRequest: Fix all current Google Play Console recommendations: edge-to-edge and deprecated APIs, keep phones portrait-only while permitting tablet landscape, enable safe R8/resource shrinking, and address Bitmap warning.
requirements: Use supported Android edge-to-edge behavior and remove the app-owned legacy orientation policy.
Keep phones portrait-only and allow normal portrait/landscape rotation on tablets at smallestScreenWidthDp >= 600.
Keep code minification and enable release resource shrinking without removing the dynamically resolved notification icon.
Investigate Bitmap warning without speculative app-source changes; verify its owning module after a new Play analysis.
nonRequirements: Do not change app features, calendar behavior, notification behavior, data, Remote Config, or deployment configuration.
Do not change third-party dependencies only to silence an unattributed Play Console warning.
Do not declare Play Console recommendations resolved before a newly processed release is inspected.
classification: Complex: Android lifecycle/window-inset, device-form-factor orientation, and release shrinker behavior cross module boundaries.

roleReports.result: Confirmed phone portrait lock in MainActivity, no direct app-owned edge-to-edge styling, release resource shrinking disabled, no direct BitmapFactory/inSampleSize usage, and bitmap assets only. Recommended Gradle lint/release verification and no speculative external changes.
Specified edge-to-edge, smallest-width orientation, safe resource shrinking, and conditional Bitmap attribution; excluded unverified third-party changes and required release/device/Play verification.

Applied WindowCompat edge-to-edge, phone/tablet orientation boundary, and release resource shrinking while retaining keep.xml for ic_stat_planflow. Verified :app:compileDebugKotlin exit 0, XML parsing, static checks, and git diff --check. Bitmap app-source change intentionally omitted because no direct source owner was found.
Added source-contract coverage for edge-to-edge, smallest-width orientation boundary, shrinkResources=true, and keep.xml notification icon preservation.

No blocker/high finding. Required follow-ups: real phone/tablet orientation smoke, release AAB install with notification/widget resource smoke, and Play Console Bitmap warning attribution after a new processed release.
Current final diff is within the allowed source/test scope. Focused contract test and git diff --check were rerun by integration. Acceptance is fail-closed pending release/device/Play evidence.
